attribution.note: Marcus's own bullet in his own post, given as one of five signs. He wrote and endorsed it.

semantics.note: This is a terse factual assertion that Meta's financing arrangements had been revealed. 'Games' and 'ominous' are kept as Marcus's own judgments and not added to. Observation is the right kind.

contract.note: The contract chooses Hyperion as the referent and sets a one-month lookback; Marcus supplied neither. An informed reader in November 2025 would most likely take Hyperion as the referent, so this plain reading is ordinary and fair. Only the factual core is tested. 'Games' is not scored as an allegation.

evidence.note: Reuters, dated 2025-10-16 and inside the period, relays Bloomberg's report that Hyperion's debt sits in an SPV and that Meta is not the borrower. This is secondary reporting, but it is dated and relevant.
Blue Owl's counsel announced on 2025-10-21 the joint venture, Meta's lease agreements and a residual value guarantee. It is a participant-side disclosure inside the period.

reviews.rationale: Two dated sources inside the Oct 11–Nov 11, 2025 window show that Meta's Hyperion financing used a separate entity and was made public. This meets the support condition. The packet contains no counterevidence. Whether the deal amounts to 'games' or an 'ominous' sign is Marcus's opinion and is not scored. The result depends on the contract's choice of Hyperion as referent, which is a reasonable choice.
